ownership: DHome2 registry and its behavioral test source only; C's existing release API/caller signature unchanged; Root integration and physical proof
evidence: Registry revoke currently marks active leases revoked without stopping a VM. A conflict query restricted to state=active can therefore hide an unknown still-mounted home writer after an owner explicitly recreates/rebinds the computer
decision: Revocation removes permission, not physical ownership. Preserve process/collect lease tombstones as held cleanup reservations until the trusted caller has independently proved the original VM/process stopped and collection settled. Do not fabricate a VM-stop proof, automatically retry/respawn, delete the home or infer stopped from a metadata fence
acquire: Atomic acquire_worker_home rejects another execution/epoch's process or collect lease in either active or revoked state; a revoked same execution is never resurrected. Released historical rows do not block a new execution. Existing current/home checks still require active exact binding/epoch/capabilities and both active exact leases
release_api: Unchanged release_worker_home(&mut self, computer_id:&str, ghost_id:&str, execution_id:&str, authority_epoch:u64)->anyhow::Result<()>
release_epoch: For cleanup only, authority_epoch names the exact original target lease epoch. Authenticate the computer's unchanged current Ghost owner and reject a future target epoch; allow cleanup of the exact old target pair after a binding fence/revocation. It is not a grant, need not require currently offered/accepted capabilities, and may transition only that exact active/revoked pair to released. Never touch another execution, a different epoch's rows, a foreign Ghost or an unknown/missing pair. Exact already-released target pair is idempotent
caller_proof: C retains its mandatory known-no-spawn or actual stopped+collected proof before any release call; on unknown cleanup it calls no release and preserves the reservations. Root will exercise an actual stopped VM and an unknown cleanup boundary separately
wire_individual_leases: For backend apple-native-omp only, reject legacy wire method lease for process/collect: native actors must use the atomic exact home API, not two independent generic grants or legacy ON CONFLICT resurrection. Existing generic ComputerBackend/browser behavior and wire protocol version remain unchanged
regressions: revocation plus explicit recreate/rebind cannot hide an uncollected prior writer
known stopped original old-epoch cleanup releases only its exact tombstone pair and enables a distinct new attempt
native individual process/collect grants cannot bypass atomic acquisition
